SecretAnalyserBeta.name: Secret Analyser Beta
SecretAnalyserBeta.notes: Fixes typing in the bug / wish window and clicks that went through to a plugin behind it. Update notice now shows on open. Install, then restart your DAW.

SecretDynamicsRelease.name: Secret Dynamics
SecretDynamicsRelease.notes: On Mac, switches such as Auto now react to the first click. Includes everything from 3.0.1: a new final touch for loudness and punch, plus Hold and Learn. Install, then restart your DAW.

SecretAnalyser.name: Secret Analyser
SecretAnalyser.notes: Frequency numbers now sit below the display, unnamed tracks are numbered, clearer buttons at the top, full Look menu names and new interface colours in grey, black, white and orange.
SecretAnalyser.notes_de: Frequenzzahlen stehen jetzt unter dem Messbild, Spuren ohne Namen werden nummeriert, klarere Knöpfe oben, volle Namen im Look-Menü und neue Oberflächenfarben in Grau, Schwarz, Weiß und Orange.

SecretFutureEQ4.name: Secret Future EQ 4
SecretFutureEQ4.notes: Improved stability when opening the window, plus a cleaner view. Install, then restart your DAW.
SecretFutureEQ4.notes_de: Stabilität beim Öffnen des Fensters verbessert, dazu eine aufgeräumtere Ansicht. Installieren, dann die DAW neu starten.

SVPEQ4.name: Secret Future EQ 2
SVPEQ4.notes: New: Feedback button to report a bug or request a feature. Fixed: Audio Unit now reports version 2.0.1.

SecretDynamicsBeta.name: Secret Dynamics Beta
SecretDynamicsBeta.notes: Fixes typing in the bug / wish window and clicks that went through to a plugin behind it. Update notice now shows on open. Install, then restart your DAW.
